prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet Companion", "Select a personality and appearance style for your new desktop friend.", "Select Pet Style", "Playful, Calm, or Energetic", "Pet Live Preview"]
1: ["Mastering Your Desktop Companion", "Quickly learn how to summon, move, and interact with your pet on your desktop.", "Desktop Gestures Animation", "Control Shortcuts", "Right-click to open menu | Drag to move | Double-click to speak", "Got It, Let's Go!"]
2: ["Save Your New Pet to Cloud Account", "Create or sign into your account to securely link your adoption certificate."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Environment...", "We are verifying your display settings to ensure your pet renders cleanly.", "Screen Diagnostic Active", "Desktop Sync Status", "Test Desktop Visibility"]
4: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Your account keeps your pet safety saved across reinstallation and computer restarts.", "Using the same email guarantees your pet progress and customized assets are restored."]
5: ["Official Adoption Certificate & Free Starter Toy!", "Congratulations! Your adoption comes with a free starter toy accessory for your desktop pet.", "Unlocked: Golden Bell Collar"]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "For best results, upload well-lit photos facing forward without obscured features.", "Avoid blurry images, extreme angles, or dark shadows for optimal 3D rendering."]
7: ["Bringing Your Companion to Life", "Generation Steps", "Building 3D Mesh | Applying Textures | Rigging Animations", "Estimated Time Remaining"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop!", "Your pet is now active in your taskbar. Drag it anywhere or click to interact.", "Pet Companion", "Launch Companion Now"]
9: ["Tip: Choose 'Instant Companion' for 1-click setup, or 'Custom Pet' for photo personalization.", "Recommended: Quick Setup takes under 30 seconds!"]
